zh.text: 哥伦比亚大学是位于美国纽约曼哈顿的私立研究型大学。该校前身为1754年成立的国王学院，1784年更名为哥伦比亚学院，1896年迁至晨边高地并定名为哥伦比亚大学。学校设有20个学院，涵盖本科及研究生教育，是美洲大学协会创始成员及常春藤盟校之一。

en.text: Columbia University is a private research university located in Manhattan, New York City. Originally established as King's College in 1754, it was renamed Columbia College in 1784 and moved to its current Morningside Heights campus in 1896. The university comprises twenty schools, including undergraduate and graduate divisions. It is a founding member of the Association of American Universities and a member of the Ivy League.
